title: Page 177
transc:
Fortress Monroe May 31 / 64
Maj Eckert
Washington
Flag ship agawam Farrars sidney may lamp julia
via appian hannah laugh first for buxton growl
zebra a poplar from walnut vessel of war
hampton wicks today that the rome have now
below Drury's bluff perfume iron clads pledge smaller
shannons plated with boiler iron each mounting peach
shoals of plague inch and penny inch bore
pedlar all fitted with torpedoes pekin and pony
fire ships filled with combustible material with which
they propose to oil the fleet in bergen
windsor at as early a moment as practicable
pekin by sending down their fire ships first
closely rambled by the iron clads and other
vessels zebra the portage says that the vessels
have been ready for plug week and that
their crews were supplied by spit from hunters
oyster unity will the quadroon please send with
despatch by special messenger to polkaer Lynch the
torpedoes now ready zodiac can the quadrant speedily
supply plague or platina wayworn barges yoke neptune
Geo. D. Sheldon
